queue.intro: Follow supplied send, arrival and response clocks through the Python matching book.
queue.scope: Synthetic limit/cancel replay. Integer prices are CNY cents and clocks are elapsed nanoseconds. Nautilus product depth integration and real queue calibration require separate acceptance.
queue.order: At each price, left to right follows FIFO arrival order.
